affix.skycraft.maker.abah_corsair.desc: Brass-fitted boarding gear waterproofed with pitch in the hidden coves of Hew's Bane.
affix.skycraft.maker.akaviri_tempered.de: Differential clay-tempered edge bearing the wave-line of the old Dragonguard armouries.
affix.skycraft.maker.altmer_glass_spun.d: Filigree malachite and moonstone drawn on high-elven mandrels descended from Direnni workshops.
affix.skycraft.maker.argonian_hist_cured: Steeped in marsh-sap lacquer that shrugs off brackish fen water and salt fog alike.
affix.skycraft.maker.ayleid_etched.desc: Chased with starlight latticework recovered from white-stone vaults of the Heartland.
affix.skycraft.maker.bosmer_bone.desc: Sinew-bound horn and cured bone laminated without touching living timber.
Stamped with a chartered Iliac guildhall touchmark and balanced for chivalric tournament lists.
affix.skycraft.maker.dunmer_bonemold.des: Resin-cured ash-bone and chitin plates laminated against cinders by Velothi outlanders.
affix.skycraft.maker.dwemer_wrought.desc: Cast in tonal brass-alloy that resists rust even after centuries beneath steam conduits.
affix.skycraft.maker.imperial_legion_iss: Quartermaster-inspected steel stamped with the cohort numeral of an Imperial border garrison.
affix.skycraft.maker.khajiit_moon_forged: Curved caravan steel polished with fine dune-silica for silent draw along desert roads.
affix.skycraft.maker.markarth_silver.des: Karth-gorge iron chased with Cidhna silver wire by crag-smiths of the western Reach.
affix.skycraft.maker.orsinium_forged.des: Beaten over Wrothgarian anthracite by stronghold smith-wives who alloy iron with green orichalcum.
affix.skycraft.maker.redguard_folded.des: Watered steel folded twelve times in Dragontail charcoal according to Ra Gada sword-canon.
affix.skycraft.maker.skyforge.desc: Quenched beside the eagle-stone above Jorrvaskr where ancient hearth-coal never cools.
affix.skycraft.maker.windhelm_hearth.des: Thick winter-forged plate hammered beside the White River docks to endure Sea of Ghosts gales.
affix.skycraft.storied.alikr_volenfell_s: Scoured bright by salt-devil winds where Rourken's bronze hammer first struck the desert basin.
affix.skycraft.storied.anticlere_charter: Pledged as surety between two feuding hill-barons before the border keep consolidated their valleys.
affix.skycraft.storied.bangkorai_ephesus: Held the canyon parapet when garrison shield-lines turned back three northern invading armies.
affix.skycraft.storied.bjoulsae_evermor_: Hung from a river-warden's saddle during the border cavalry campaigns along the Druadach foothills.
affix.skycraft.storied.craglorn_star_cai: Forged from meteoric iron gathered beneath the shattered observatory domes of old Craglorn.
affix.skycraft.storied.daggerfall_crynga: Trampled into heather mud when King Lysandus fell before the arrow-storm on the southern moors.
affix.skycraft.storied.daggerfall_numidi: Bears two conflicting royal timestamps from the day the Brass God folded six kingdoms into four.
affix.skycraft.storied.dragontail_scourg: Quenched in sulphurous mountain runoff where Dragontail pass-sentries watch the northern ridge.
affix.skycraft.storied.dwynnen_bhoriane_: Carried across the stony river causeway when Duke Eadwyre's lancers broke the western coastal raiders.
affix.skycraft.storied.eastmarch_ysgramo: Notched with tally-marks along its guard by a shield-thane who sailed south from Atmora's freezing shoals.
affix.skycraft.storied.falkreath_pine_el: Lifted from a mossy jarl-cairn under dripping Falkreath pines where funeral bells toll every autumn.
affix.skycraft.storied.glenumbra_camlorn: Tempered during the autumn muster when Direnni spell-captains broke the Alessian host on the moors.
affix.skycraft.storied.haafingar_wolf_wa: Sealed inside a lead reliquary beneath the Blue Palace after Potema's necromancers were driven from the arch.
affix.skycraft.storied.hews_bane_hubalaj: Smuggled out of Taneth's harbour vaults on the night the southern sea-lanes changed hands.
affix.skycraft.storied.hjaalmarch_bromju: Unearthed beneath peat and bog-myrtle outside the shattered stone ring of Labyrinthian.
affix.skycraft.storied.pale_korvanjund_v: Kept greased in horker tallow by sentries who guarded the Jagged Crown's subterranean stair.
affix.skycraft.storied.reach_old_hroldan: Hammered where storm-magic cracked the limestone battlements above the Karth gorge.
affix.skycraft.storied.rift_forelhost_re: Recovered from the poisoned cistern terraces high above the golden birch valleys of the Rift.
affix.skycraft.storied.rivenspire_doomcr: Inscribed with silver containment runes after the Ebon Crypt fissure poisoned the western chalk ridges.
affix.skycraft.storied.sentinel_first_la: Etched with the prow-sigil of the Ra Gada captains who anchored beneath Sentinel's red headland.
affix.skycraft.storied.stormhaven_abbey_: Blessed with rosemary oil by chantry wardens who patrol the old pilgrim road above Wayrest Sound.
affix.skycraft.storied.stros_hunding_pro: Salvaged from the charred flagship timbers after Prince A'tor's fleet burned in the southern bay.
affix.skycraft.storied.wayrest_direnni_s: Stamped with a swan-and-tower countermark from the merchant princes who raised the harbour sea-chain.
affix.skycraft.storied.whiterun_jorrvask: Sworn over upturned mead-plank timber when the Five Hundred first climbed onto the windy tundra bluff.
affix.skycraft.storied.whiterun_watchtow: Scorched along the fuller during the night the western watchtower stones cracked under dragonfire.
affix.skycraft.storied.winterhold_saarth: Pulled from the collapsed cliff-rubble after the Sea of Ghosts swallowed three-quarters of the old capital.
affix.skycraft.storied.wrothgar_paragon_: Salvaged from the vitrified gate-stones of old Orsinium after the thirty-year siege finally ended.
